 out=[]
 for j in range(5):
  a,b,c,d=[i for i in range(5)if i!=j];out.append(s.expand((-1)**j*(P[a,b]*P[c,d]-P[a,c]*P[b,d]+P[a,d]*P[b,c])))
 return s.Matrix(out)

for a,b in pairs:
 c,d,f=[i for i in range(5)if i not in(a,b)];perm=[a,b,c,d,f];sign=(-1)**sum(perm[i]>perm[j]for i in range(5)for j in range(i+1,5))
 value=s.expand(sign*((dp[c].T*dphi[d]*dp[f])[0]+(dp[f].T*dphi[c]*dp[d])[0]+(dp[d].T*dphi[f]*dp[c])[0]));omega[a,b]=value;omega[b,a]=-value

J={ijk:s.expand(sum(O[i,l]*s.diff(O[j,k],x[l])+O[j,l]*s.diff(O[k,i],x[l])+O[k,l]*s.diff(O[i,j],x[l])for l in range(5)))for ijk in triples for i,j,k in[ijk]}
assert not any(J.values());projective={inds:s.expand(sum((-1)**at*x[l]*J[inds[:at]+inds[at+1:]]for at,l in enumerate(inds)))for inds in quads};assert not any(projective.values())

 ij=ast.literal_eval(key);target[ij]=s.sympify(v,locals={str(t):t for t in x});target[ij[::-1]]=-target[ij]

assert (P0-ratio*target).applyfunc(s.expand)==s.zeros(5)
q0=x[0]*x[2]-x[1]**2;q1=x[0]*x[3]-x[1]*x[2];q2=x[1]*x[3]-x[2]**2
r1=x[4]*x[1]-x[2]*x[3]+x[0]**2;r2=x[4]*x[2]-x[3]**2+x[0]*x[1];q=s.Matrix([q0,q1,q2,r1,r2])
F=s.expand(x[4]*q0*q2+q2*(x[2]*q2-x[3]*q1)+q0*(x[0]*q1-x[1]*q0));det0=s.expand(q.jacobian(x).det());assert det0==-2*F

pf=s.expand((s.Matrix(x).T*pfs(O))[0]);detg=s.expand(g.jacobian(z).det().subs(subs,simultaneous=True));pf_ratio=s.cancel(pf/detg);assert pf_ratio and not pf_ratio.free_symbols
assert s.expand(pf.subs(e,0)-ratio**2*s.sympify(old['actual_signed_Euler_Pfaffian'],locals={str(t):t for t in x}))==0

assert all(s.expand(qq.subs(dict(zip(x,param)),simultaneous=True))==0 for qq in q)
